ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. run
   C. quickly
   D. blue

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. No full stops

3. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.

4. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.

5. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

6. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.

7. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. Where is the Library
   D. where is the library

9. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only an action
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

10. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.

11. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language School.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.

12. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goed
   C. went
   D. goes

13. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.

14. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.

15. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Language Welcome and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Pre Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Phonics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
